## OpenUtau Mobile 1.3.0

> **Vibe-coded with AI.** The additions in this app were written by [Claude](https://claude.com/claude-code) (Anthropic's AI, Claude Sonnet 5.5), directed by sparky-commits1637. The code has not been hand-reviewed and the new features are untested on a device, so please report problems.

### What's new in 1.3.0
- **Lyrics placed by timing.** *Transcribe lyrics with Moonshine* now uses a **wav2vec2** aligner (optional `wav2vec2` dependency) to find *when* each syllable is sung and puts it on the note at that time. Before, lyrics were dealt out in order, so one merged or split note pushed every later lyric onto the wrong note. Now a mistake stays on that one note.
- Notes with no syllable under them get `+`. Two syllables on one merged note keep the stronger one; notes are not split.
- Without the wav2vec2 package, lyrics still work the old way (in order). The Extract notes dialog shows which mode you will get.

### Updating
- Signed with the same key as the previous releases, so it installs over them and keeps your data.
- The package name is unchanged, so it still installs separately from the official OpenUtau Mobile. Android **ARM64** only.
- English speech only, like Moonshine. Singing will align less well. The wav2vec2 model is large (about 380 MB on disk).
